Modern.brandNameRationale: Anchor: Friedrich Froebel's 1837 'gifts' — the original pedagogical building blocks that founded the kindergarten movement and inspired Frank Lloyd Wright's design education. Picked from Agent A's three for the cleanest pedagogy-meets-design anchor.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern toys have moved past plastic franchises toward design-led wooden goods. The opening is for a brand that names a pedagogical heritage and stays in the considered-design register.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Grimm's (grimms.eu) plays the design-led wooden-toy peer. Plan Toys (plantoys.com) holds the considered-modern middle. Maileg (maileg.com) is the editorial-craft reference. We sit alongside Grimm's with sharper pedagogy framing.
Modern.positioningStatement: Froebel & Form is a modern wooden-toy brand drawing on Froebel's 1837 pedagogical gifts.

targetAudience.primary: Parents 28-45 who buy considered wooden toys and care about pedagogy.
behaviors: Care about wood source and finish

dos: Name the gift number and the pedagogy
Show toys in real children's hands

Modern.logoDirection: Wordmark: FROEBEL & FORM set in a modern serif, two lines with a long ampersand. Small mark: a single cube-and-sphere silhouette (Gift #2) used on tags.

typography.primary: Tiempos Headline for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: Söhne for body and gift descriptions
typography.rationale: A contrast serif plus a clean grotesk — the design-pedagogy register.

Luxury.brandNameRationale: Anchor: Froebel's pedagogical 'gifts' as a connoisseur's cabinet of considered wooden objects. Counter to Maison Erzgebirge (region-as-name works but reads generic) and Saxony & Sons (sons-suffix overused). Cabinet evokes both the wooden case and the curator's frame.
Luxury.industrySummary: Luxury toys are a small editorial category — heirloom wooden objects, hand-finished pieces, archival-grade craft. Buyers pay for provenance and the family-archive frame.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Vilac (vilac.com) plays the heritage French wooden-toy peer. Anamalz (anamalz.com) holds the editorial-craft middle. Ostheimer (ostheimer.de) is the heritage Waldorf reference. We sit as a cabinet-curated heritage house.
Luxury.positioningStatement: The Froebel Cabinet is a luxury wooden-toy house presenting Froebel's pedagogical gifts as hand-finished heirloom pieces.

targetAudience.primary: Grandparents and design-literate parents buying heirloom-grade wooden toys for grandchildren.

dos: Name the gift number and the wood
Treat each piece as an archival object
Send a paper card with each order

Luxury.logoDirection: Wordmark: THE FROEBEL CABINET set in a refined book serif, three lines centered. A small mark — a single cabinet-key silhouette — used as the seal.

typography.primary: Caslon for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: Garamond Premier Pro for body and gift descriptions
typography.rationale: Two classical English serifs — the cabinet-of-curiosities register.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the kindergarten building block — the foundational Froebel object and the archetypal childhood toy. Single noun, deeply specific to early-years play. Picked from Agent A's three (Gift, Block, Horse) for the cleanest minimal anchor.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimalist toy brands serve the design-literate parent market that wants one good wooden object rather than a catalog.
Minimal.competitorLandscape: Areaware (areaware.com) plays the design-object peer. Hay Kids (hay.dk) holds the modern-design middle. Naef Spiele (naefspiele.ch) is the wooden-toy-design reference. We sit as a single-block minimal brand.
Minimal.positioningStatement: Block is a minimal toy brand selling a single set of wooden building blocks.

targetAudience.primary: Parents 28-45 who buy one considered wooden toy.

dos: Name the wood and the finish

Minimal.logoDirection: Wordmark: BLOCK set very large in a clean modern sans, five letters, one word. No symbol.

typography.primary: ABC Diatype for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: ABC Diatype Mono for product specs
typography.rationale: Clean Diatype with its mono — the single-object register.

Corporate.tagline: Wooden toys, since the Ore Mountains.
Corporate.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the Erzgebirge (Ore Mountains) region of Saxony — the centuries-old German wooden-toy heartland that produced the Seiffen craft tradition and brands like Wendt & Kühn. Toy Works follows the heritage-industrial naming convention.
Corporate.industrySummary: Multi-brand toy operators with regional heritage anchors are a real B2B category — companies that own portfolios of wooden-toy brands serving specialty retailers and licensors.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: Spin Master (spinmaster.com) plays the modern multi-brand peer. Ravensburger (ravensburger.com) holds the heritage-German peer slot. Mattel (mattel.com) is the institutional reference. We sit as a regional wooden-toy operator with Erzgebirge heritage.
Corporate.positioningStatement: Erzgebirge Toy Works operates a portfolio of wooden-toy brands rooted in the Ore Mountains craft tradition.

targetAudience.primary: Toy brand founders considering sale, specialty toy retail buyers, and licensing directors.
behaviors: Care about wood sourcing and safety testing

donts: No social media at the parent level

Corporate.logoDirection: Wordmark: ERZGEBIRGE TOY WORKS set in an institutional serif, three lines. A small mark — a stylized pine-and-mountain silhouette — used on contracts.

typography.primary: Tiempos Headline for the wordmark and headlines
typography.rationale: A reading serif plus a clean grotesk — the heritage-operator register.

Creative.brandNameRationale: Anchor: Friedrich Froebel coined 'kindergarten' (children's garden) in 1837 to describe the educational environment his gifts were designed for. The word now belongs to the public domain across the world, but its toy-pedagogy origin is editorially rich.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative toy brands work the editorial-pedagogy market — toys with stories, named gifts, and historical narratives. The kindergarten origin story is underused as a brand frame.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Maileg (maileg.com) plays the editorial-craft peer. Ostheimer (ostheimer.de) holds the Waldorf-craft middle. Plan Toys (plantoys.com) is the sustainability reference. We sit as a kindergarten-pedagogy-led brand.
Creative.positioningStatement: The Kindergarten is a creative toy brand making wooden gifts in the Froebel pedagogy tradition.

targetAudience.primary: Parents 28-45 who read pedagogy and buy toys with stories.
behaviors: Read Montessori, Waldorf, and Reggio Emilia materials

dos: Name the gift number and the pedagogy

Creative.logoDirection: Wordmark: THE KINDERGARTEN set in a warm display serif, two lines centered. A small mark — a single seedling-and-cube silhouette — used on tags.

typography.primary: GT Sectra for the wordmark and headlines
typography.rationale: A warm display serif plus a clean grotesk — the kindergarten storybook register.
